care.title: Customer Care
care.text: We are a family-run business in Den Bosch, dedicated to bringing you the best in art prints. Each piece is printed and framed with love and care, ensuring that you receive a product that is not only beautiful but also crafted with attention to detail. Visit us, enjoy a coffee, and see where the magic happens.

colours.title: Vibrant Colors & Versatile Sizes

Each piece is crafted to meet your specifications, ensuring a unique addition to your home or office.

about.family: We're a family business in the Netherlands, run by a husband and wife team.
about.story1: We've always loved camping trips, travelling, and spontaneous road trips—the kind where you stop for a view, take a photo, and later wish you could keep that feeling around. That's a big part of why PrintMe exists.
about.story2: Our prints and frames are made to bring that "good moment" onto your walls: clean, beautiful, and easy to live with. Whether it's calm nature vibes, bold photography, or something that just feels like you, we hope it turns your house into a home.
about.intro1: We create museum-quality giclée prints made to look stunning up close and stay beautiful for years.
about.intro2: Our collection is inspired by the places we love most—camping mornings, long road trips, quiet nature spots, and the simple calm you feel when you step outside for a bit. We try to capture that mood and bring it into your home.
about.intro3: Every print is produced with care, using premium materials and sharp, true-to-life color. Clean, timeless, and made to live with—so your walls feel more like you.
about.factsText: We're impartial and independent, and every day we create distinctive, world-class programmes and content
about.imageAlt: Fashion designers collaborating in a bright studio
about.v1Text: Archival inks on premium paper. Made to last decades, not months. The kind of quality you'd expect in a gallery.
about.v2Text: Pick your size, choose your frame, add a mat. Your art, your way—without the custom framing markup.
about.v3Text: Simple ordering, fast shipping, real humans if you need help. No hoops, no surprises, just smooth.
about.f1Text: Crafted with care and top-notch Giclée technology
about.f2Text: Family-owned business led by two passionate engineers

how.intro: PrintMeArt is a family-run studio in Den Bosch. We make prints that are meant to look great in real homes: sharp up close, clean in the highlights, and rich in the shadows—without the "cheap poster" feel. This page explains what happens between your click and the moment it lands on your wall.
how.shortText: You choose the artwork (ours or yours), customize it (paper, size, frame), preview the result, and place the order. From there, we focus on getting the final print to look intentional: balanced framing, clean edges, and a consistent finish. If something doesn't meet our standard, it doesn't go out.
how.step1Text: You can shop from our curated collection, or bring your own image. If it's your own file, the goal is simple: make it look like it belongs on a wall, not just on a screen.
how.step2Text: Choose your paper type, select the size, and add a frame if you want a ready-to-hang result. The preview is there so you can see the overall look before you commit—especially important for cropping and borders.
how.step3Text: We don't just "hit print." We make sure the final result looks clean and premium: sensible cropping, neat alignment, and a finished presentation that works with your chosen frame and size.
how.step4Text: Your print is produced with a fine-art giclée process for detail and smooth tone transitions. After printing, we check for the things you'd notice immediately: clean edges, consistent tones, and a tidy final result.
how.papersText: Museum-grade cotton papers. All 308-310 gsm, fade-resistant, and built to last.
how.photoRagText: Premium German fine art paper with natural white tone. Museum-grade archival quality used by galleries worldwide.
how.etchingText: Traditional German mould-made paper with visible texture. Originally designed for printmaking, now a favorite for fine art.
how.canonText: Clean, neutral matte finish with high detail. Premium rag paper feel with a soft fine-art look. Ideal for color-critical photography.
how.posterText: Vivid, accurate colors with stunning depth. Smooth matte finish for glare-free display. Best value for everyday art.
how.chooseText: Think about your artwork and what matters most to you.
how.choose1Text: Soft, natural colors with a gallery feel. Smooth surface brings out fine details without distraction. Our most versatile choice.
how.choose2Text: Visible texture adds a hand-painted, tactile quality. Makes brushstrokes feel real. Great for classical art or expressive works.
how.choose3Text: Maximum color accuracy and deep blacks. Perfect tonal range from highlights to shadows. Ideal when precise color reproduction matters.
how.choose4Text: Same giclée printing quality on a lighter paper. Vivid colors, smooth matte finish. Perfect for decorating without the premium price.
how.notSureText: Go with Photo Rag—it works beautifully for almost anything. All our premium papers are museum-quality, fade-resistant for 100+ years, and printed with the same 12-color giclée process.
how.framingText: Framing is optional, but it's the fastest way to make a print feel "done." It also adds everyday protection during handling and display. If you're not sure which frame works best, think in simple terms:
how.careText: For the best longevity, avoid constant direct sunlight and keep prints away from high humidity spots. If you frame it, display behind glazing for extra protection and easier cleaning. Treat it like a good jacket: it'll last longer if you don't leave it in the rain.
how.faqPosterA: Not in the "thin paper, quick print" sense. Our focus is fine-art printing and a finished look, whether you buy from our collection or upload your own image.
how.faqOwn: Can I print my own photo or artwork?
how.faqOwnA: Yes. Upload your file, customize the size/paper/frame, preview it, and order. If you want it to feel truly premium, pick a size that matches your image well instead of forcing extreme cropping.
how.faqMatteA: Both work. Matte is softer and more "gallery," semi-gloss usually makes colors and contrast feel more lively. Your room lighting is the deciding factor.
how.faqShippingA: Orders are delivered within {{days}} days. We always use tracked shipping so you know when to expect it.
how.readyText: Shop our prints or upload your own design.
how.canonAlt: Canson Infinity Rag Photographique II paper

licensing.intro: We believe great art should be accessible. Here's where our collection comes from and how we handle credits.
licensing.title: Licensing & Credits
licensing.pdTagline: Public domain art, curated with care.
licensing.sourcesText: Most artworks in our collection are in the public domain, sourced from world-renowned museums:
licensing.whyPdText: Public domain artworks are free from copyright restrictions, allowing anyone to print, share, and enjoy them. We carefully select high-resolution images to ensure museum-quality prints.
licensing.openLicenseText: Some of our prints feature stunning photography from talented creators who generously share their work under open licenses. These images are free to use and print.
licensing.creditText: While not always required, we appreciate and acknowledge the photographers whose work appears in our collection. Their generosity makes beautiful prints accessible to everyone.
licensing.responsibilityText: When you upload your own images for custom prints, you confirm that:
licensing.own: You own the image or have the right to print it
licensing.noInfringe: The image doesn't infringe on anyone's copyright or trademark
licensing.guidelines: The content complies with our acceptable use guidelines
licensing.noKeepText: Custom uploads are processed for printing only. We don't keep, share, or reuse your personal images right after your order is complete.
licensing.respond: We'll review and respond within 2-3 business days.

legal.intro: Everything you need to know about shipping, returns, and how we handle your data. We keep it simple and fair.
legal.shipFrom: We ship from Den Bosch, Netherlands with care.
legal.guaranteeText: All orders are delivered within 30 days. If we can't meet this, you may cancel for a full refund.
legal.daysToDecide: {{days}} days to decide. No questions asked.
legal.step1: Email us at support@printme.art with your order number
legal.step2: We'll send you a return shipping label
legal.step3: Pack the item securely and drop it off
legal.extendedText: We offer {{days}} days to return your order — longer than the 14-day legal minimum (bedenktijd). Simply email us at support@printmeart.nl to start a return.
legal.condition: Items must be in original, undamaged condition. Custom prints (your own uploaded designs) are excluded from the right of withdrawal, unless there's a quality issue.
legal.generalText: By using our website and services, you agree to these terms. We sell museum-quality giclée prints and frames. All product images are representative; slight color variations may occur due to monitor settings.
legal.pricingText: All prices shown include BTW (Dutch VAT). Shipping costs are displayed separately before checkout.
legal.ordersText: Payment is processed securely through iDEAL, credit card, and Klarna. By placing an order, you're making an offer to purchase which we'll confirm via email. The purchase agreement is formed when we send this confirmation.
legal.ipText: Our curated collection features public domain artworks. Original content, website design, and branding are © PrintMe Art. You may not reproduce our website content without permission.
legal.warrantyText: You have legal warranty rights (wettelijke garantie). If your product doesn't match what you ordered or is defective, contact us and we'll resolve it — repair, replacement, or refund.
legal.law: These terms are governed by Dutch law. Any disputes will be handled by the courts of 's-Hertogenbosch.
legal.complaintsTagline: We want to make it right.
legal.complainText: If you're not satisfied with our products or service, please let us know. We take all complaints seriously and aim to resolve them fairly and quickly.
legal.withOrder: with your order number and a clear description of the issue
legal.acknowledge: We'll acknowledge your complaint within 2 business days
legal.resolve: We aim to resolve complaints within 14 days
legal.odr: If we can't reach a solution together, you can submit your complaint to the European Online Dispute Resolution platform:
legal.dontSell: Sell your data to third parties
legal.dontTrack: Track you across websites without your consent
legal.cookiesText: We use cookies and similar technologies to understand how our website is used and to measure advertising performance. We only enable non-essential tracking after you give consent in the cookie banner.
legal.googleText: Used for analytics and ad conversion measurement. When enabled, Google may set cookies/identifiers to help measure visits and campaign performance.
legal.insightsText: Used to monitor site performance and errors (telemetry). When enabled, it may use browser storage/cookies to help understand sessions and diagnose issues.
legal.withdraw: You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing your browser storage. If you have questions, contact us at support@printmeart.nl.
legal.rightsText: Under European privacy law, you have the right to:
legal.retentionText: We keep order data for 7 years (legal requirement for tax purposes). Account data is kept until you delete your account. Custom uploaded images are deleted after order completion.
legal.exercise: To exercise your rights or ask questions, email support@printmeart.nl — we'll respond within 30 days.
